title: ISS ECLSS
description: Documented public operational life support (NASA) for the Closed-Loop Life Support Simulator capability area.
body:
ISS ECLSS is a documented operational life support from NASA. The International Space Station's Environmental Control and Life Support System: regenerates ~98% of water and much of the oxygen — the working closed-loop reference.

How it works: It works by enforcing in - out + generated = accumulation over the control volume and checking that the balance closes.

Documented uses of this capability area include interplanetary trajectory design, space-station operations, lunar base planning, and asteroid resource assessment.
